name: comp-151
title: Vertical Checkbox Group
blurb: Multiple checkboxes stacked vertically in a grid.
description: Vertical checkbox group with three pre-made options (React, Next.js, Astro). Uses CSS grid for spacing. Demonstrates multi-select in column layout.
use_when: Presenting stacked independent options in forms.
a11y: Each checkbox properly labeled and associated. Full keyboard navigation. No ARIA group.
